message: Cannot instantiate a custom attribute: cannot find the compile-time type '{0}'. Make sure that the type exists and is annotated with [CompileTime] or [RunTimeOrCompileTime].
rationale: The message uses the outdated term 'build-time' instead of 'compile-time'. AttributeDeserializer.TryCreateAttribute reports it when CompileTimeTypeResolver.GetCompileTimeType returns null for the attribute type, typically because the attribute type is run-time-only.
